blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: post-order — Traverse left, right, then root.
breadth-first — Visit vertices level by level.
FIFO queue — First-in-first-out structure used by BFS.
traversal — Systematically visit each node in a structure.

blocks.title: Depth-first post-order
blocks.text: Visit an entire left subtree, then right subtree, and finally the current node.

blocks.title: Breadth-first level order
blocks.text: Start with the root in a queue. Dequeue one node, visit it and enqueue each of its children.

blocks.title: Compare output
blocks.text: Same structure yields different orders: 2,6,4,12,8 versus 8,4,12,2,6.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: PostOrder(10) calls left(5), then left(2). At node2 both null-child calls return, so print2; return to node5 and print5.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model the reasoning
blocks.text: Return to10, traverse right child15 and print15, then print10. Output 2,5,15,10: the print follows both child calls. Node has Key, Left and Right fields.
